description: This file defines a ViewModel for an Android application's UI layer, managing authentication states, user actions such as login, lock, unlock, logout, and network calls to protected resources. It interacts with an AuthManager, ApiClient, and maintains observable state flows for UI updates.

classes.name: MainViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that manages authentication state, user interactions, and network requests for the main UI of the app.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with provided username and password, updates auth state and logs the process.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the current session, optionally specifying the reason.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the session after successful biometric verification.

methods.name: callProtected
methods.description: Calls a protected API endpoint, logs the response or error.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears tokens and resets auth state to logged out.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends a message to the short rolling status log with timestamp.
